overal.goal: The limiter is keyed by principal.id and runs after authenticate, so 401s (key guessing on /api/v1/whoami or /mcp) are unlimited and each costs a stat + SHA-256; /healthz is public and loads and zod-parses settings.json on every hit (scaffolding it if missing). Add a small per-IP bucket (X-Forwarded-For aware when the peer is loopback) in front of auth, and cache the health payload for a few seconds.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

unauthenticatedRateLimit runs before authenticate and charges one bucket per client address only for 401 answers (security.rateLimit.unauthenticatedPerMinute, default 30); the client address is the last X-Forwarded-For / Forwarded entry only when the peer is in security.trustedProxies (default ["loopback"], not [] as first planned: behind nginx every request arrives from loopback and one shared bucket would let anyone lock the owner out); /healthz caches runner.enabled for 5 s.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
